name: Data & log cleanup
desc: Old files under the paths you list (with sizes), journal and Docker leftovers. Cleans build cache and dangling images; proposes a journal vacuum and a stopped-container prune. Deleting files is not in this version.
prompt: For each selected host: list files older than 30 days under each watched path with files.list_older_than (only the paths configured for that host; if none are set, say so) and add up their sizes. Check the journal (journal.disk_usage) and Docker leftovers (docker.system_df). Remove dangling images and build cache with docker.prune_dangling_images and docker.prune_build_cache. Propose journal.vacuum (days 30) when the journal is over 1 GB, and docker.prune_stopped_containers (older_than_h 720) when old stopped containers exist. Report the old files found per path with total size; do not delete files.
